guide.title: Lunara's Overview
guide.text:
Lunara is a Ranged Assassin who relies on her high
Movement Speed and damage over time abilities to fight her enemies from a large
distance. She combines the ability to grant vision to her team with strong
Basic Attacks and outstanding maneuverability, especially during the later stages
of the game. As most ranged Assassins, she requires good positioning and
map awareness in order to unfold her true
strength. Lunara is a challenging Hero to master, however, she is a very
rewarding Assassin, capable of having a massive impact on team fights and
skirmishes.

guide.title: Lunara's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Strong sustain DPS in teamfights
Good PvE ability with dedicated Talents
Very mobile due to Trait
Weaknesses
Susceptible to crowd control
Fairly high learning curve
No real burst damage
Requires good positioning

guide.title: Lunara's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Lunara synergizes with
Lunara works with a variety of different Heroes and team compositions, however,
she truly shines if paired with crowd control heavy Heroes such as
Arthas, Jaina,
or Muradin who all provide plenty of Slow for
Lunara's Unfair Advantage talent at Level 16 to get value from.
Lunara is countered by
Lunara gets countered by two things: mobile Assassins like Illidan
or Genji that can chase her down even after
she used Leaping Strike and strong AoE healing provided by Healers like
Malfurion or Stukov who can shut down
Nature's Toxin's poison damage.

guide.title: Lunara's Maps
guide.text:
Lunara's stronger maps
Lunara's average maps
Lunara's weaker maps
Lunara performs quite well on most maps with the exception of
Warhead Junction where the fact that Lunara cannot use a mount causes her
to feel very clunky and slow. On Battlefield of Eternity, however, Lunara feels
even more powerful than on other battlegrounds thanks to her Level 4 talent
Nature's Culling, which allows her to inflict heavy damage
onto enemy Immortals.

guide.title: Lunara's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
The fact that Lunara cannot use a mount is a both blessing and curse. In team fights, make sure to use your increased Movement Speed to kite enemy Heroes. Out of combat, do not forget about informing your allies about your position during rotations if you are falling behind.
Leaping Strike is a great escape mechanism against hard-engaging Tanks and melee Assassins like Illidan or Muradin.
Lunara's efficiency sometimes depends on the type of Healer Hero the enemy team chose during draft. While she counters single-target Healers like Lt. Morales or Uther, her AoE damage over time gets countered by strong AoE Healers like Stukov or Malfurion.
On larger maps, Hippity Hop allows Lunara to rotate as fast as any mounted Hero, which greatly helps her to stay close to her allies.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Lunara's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Lunara shines when she is able to stack and spread
Nature's Toxin on multiple targets undisturbed. Thus,
keeping her poison active should become her primary goal. Fortunately,
abilities like Noxious Blossom and
Crippling Spores can help out greatly in that regard.
Crippling Spores, in particular, can be used to instantly refresh the duration
of Nature's Toxin and also slows each affected enemy.
Although Lunara's Heroic Abilities are quite easy to understand, it is
extremely important to know when to use them.
Thornwood Vine adds a fairly reliable source of
additional AoE damage and also allows Lunara to control her
Nature's Toxin stacks more efficiently.
Leaping Strike, on the other hand, focuses more on
mobility and repositioning. As such, you should carefully assess your own and
the enemy team composition and then decide which ability to pick at Level
10.

abilities.title: Lunara's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
The fact that Lunara cannot use a mount is a both blessing and curse. In team fights, make sure to use your increased Movement Speed to kite enemy Heroes. Out of combat, do not forget about informing your allies about your position during rotations if you are falling behind.
Leaping Strike is a great escape mechanism against hard-engaging Tanks and melee Assassins like Illidan or Muradin.
Lunara's efficiency sometimes depends on the type of Healer Hero the enemy team chose during draft. While she counters single-target Healers like Lt. Morales or Uther, her AoE damage over time gets countered by strong AoE Healers like Stukov or Malfurion.
On larger maps, Hippity Hop allows Lunara to rotate as fast as any mounted Hero, which greatly helps her to stay close to her allies.

abilities.title: Noxious Blossom
abilities.text:
Noxious Blossom
(Q)
Lunara
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 8 seconds
After 0.5 seconds, cause an area to explode with pollen dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage.
Noxious Blossom is a solid ability to spread your
first stacks of Nature's Toxin with from a safer distance,
since its casting range is larger than your normal Basic Attack range. It is
also a very useful tool to scout vision obscured terrain before facechecking it.

abilities.title: Crippling Spores
abilities.text:
Crippling Spores
(W)
Lunara
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Enemies currently afflicted by Nature's Toxin have its duration increased by 3 seconds and are Slowed by 40%, decaying over 3 seconds.
Knowing when to use Crippling Spores efficiently is
one of the most important things to master when playing Lunara. This ability is
the key to enable powerful late-game damage
granted by Unfair Advantage at Level 16.
If a team fight goes well, feel
free to use it early in order to maximise your damage. If the fight does not go
well, try to utilise Crippling Spores' slow effect to keep enemy Tanks and
melee Assassins away from you.

abilities.title: Wisp
abilities.text:
Wisp
(E)
Lunara
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Spawn a Wisp to scout an area. Can be redirected once active. When the Wisp is in a bush for more 2 seconds, its vision radius is increased by 75%. Lasts 45 seconds.
Lunara is not an easy Hero to master since she requires great positioning and
quite a lot of multi-tasking. Consequently, Wisp sometimes
becomes an underrated ability, which many players seem to forget about at some point during
the game. However, Wisp turns out to have a significant impact on the game since
it provides a lot of useful vision on your enemy team if placed wisely. Thus,
always try to keep Wisp on cooldown and remember that
is has a global casting range.

abilities.title: Thornwood Vine
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Thornwood Vine
(R)
Lunara
Heroic
Mana: 35
Charges: 3
Recharge Time: 15 seconds
Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.
Stores up to 3 charges.
One of Lunara's biggest strengths is the fact that both of her Heroic Abilities
can be used to great effect. Thornwood Vine is an excellent
long-range poking ability, which applies Nature's Toxin
to each enemy it hits. Due to the relatively short cooldown of 15 seconds per
charge, Thornwood Vine can be used to clear Minion waves as well, which makes it
a formidable Ability on maps like Dragon Shire or Tomb of the Spider Queen, where
pushing and de-pushing lanes is crucial.

abilities.title: Leaping Strike
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Leaping Strike
(R)
Lunara
Heroic
Mana: 50
Charges: 2
Recharge Time: 20 seconds
Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.
Stores up to 2 charges.
Mobility is of the essence when playing a fragile ranged Assassin like Lunara.
Thus, Leaping Strike proves to be a very important asset
to her kit, especially if you choose to play a Basic Attack oriented talent Build.
However, Leaping Strike does not only provide Lunara with a powerful engage and
disengage mechanic, it also deals a significant amount of damage and Movement Speed
slow to its target, which makes it a strong finishing ability.
Keeping track of your target's positioning is important when using
Leaping Strike, since it will always place Lunara behind
her target in a straight line. Thus, you should avoid using it if the entire
enemy team is still located behind your target. Instead, wait until a team fight
has erupted and the enemy team has spread out. Keep in mind that Leaping Strike
can also be used on Structures, which makes it a great escape mechanism if you
get caught too deep inside the enemy team's base.

abilities.title: Nature's Toxin
abilities.text:
Nature's Toxin
(D)
Lunara
Passive
Lunara's Basic Attacks and damaging Abilities poison their target, dealing 33 (+4% per level) damage a second for 3 seconds. Every additional application increases the duration by 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 9 seconds.
Nature's Toxin is a strong damage over time trait, which
allows Lunara to poison multiple enemies at the same time using her Basic Attacks and
damaging abilities. Experienced Lunara players usually try to stack Nature's Toxin as
quickly as possible and maintain the stacks active using
Crippling Spores to refresh their duration.
Stealthed Heroes like Nova, Valeera, or Zeratul,
in particular, can be kept visible
thanks to Nature's Toxin, as its poison damage prevents
them from re-stealthing.

abilities.title: Dryad's Swiftness
abilities.text:
While Dryad's Swiftness causes Lunara to be one of the most mobile Heroes
during team fights, it can also cause her to fall behind her teammates when
covering large distances around the map. Thus, we strongly recommend using
any means of communication (voice chat, ingame ping notifications, or chat messages for instance)
to alert your allies if you need more time to catch up to them.
Lunara's Level 20 talent called Galloping Gait adds an
incredibly powerful activatable component to Dryad's Swiftness, which allows
her to outrun any other Hero in the game. Use it to escape dangerous situations,
to rush to your allies' aid in time, or to chase down retreating enemies.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Sentinel Wisp provides an incredible amount of vision
and stealth-detection as long as the Wisp remains hidden in a bush. This can be
used to secure Objectives or to scout out the enemy team.
Natural Perspective is a very useful Talent, which
allows you to follow the enemy team's movements and warns you in time, should
enemies try to engage on you. Keep in mind that it also makes landing
skillshots for your allies a lot easier, since the
vision from Natural Perspective enables them to predict the movement paths of
their targets.
Hippity Hop offers a significant Movement Speed boost which allows Lunara
to rotate around the battlefield much more quickly. This prevents her
from getting caught out of position and allows her to follow up
on her teammates more easily.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Nature's Culling is good when clearing Minion waves in
order to relieve lane pressure. By the same token, it causes Lunara to deal a
significant amount of extra damage against enemy Structures and Mercenaries, which makes her a
very strong pusher.
Blossom Swell increases Noxious Blossom's radius
and range, making it easier to hit and is very useful when playing a Noxious Blossom Build.
Siphoning Toxin is only recommended in Quick Match when your team
does not have any Healer. In competitive play,
it is only recommended if you already have a decent lane clear Hero
and Nature's Culling wouldn't provide enough value.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
Thornwood Vine is a strong poking
ability, which allows Lunara to spread Nature's Toxin
from a safe distance. Due to its large casting range, Thornwood Vine enables
Lunara to outmatch most other Ranged Assassins.
While not team fighting, Thornwood Vine is also a
great tool for clearing Minion waves very quickly. However, always track the
number of charges and make sure to have
at least 1 charge ready before major
team fights.
Leaping Strike adds a lot of mobility to Lunara's kit,
which allows her to escape dangerous situations more quickly. Thus, it is our
prefered choice when playing Lunara as it offers her a lot of utility.
During the animation of Leaping Strike, Lunara gets some
Unstoppable frames.
If timed correctly, Leaping Strike can be used to negate some enemy Abilities
(notably Temporal Loop by Chromie).
It is quite important to carefully observe the enemy team's position before
using Leaping Strike. Do not use Leaping Strike if it would
position yourself close to the rest of the enemy team. Instead, use it as an escape
mechanism or to finish off retreating enemies.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Let Them Wither paves the way for incredible late-game damage output
since it prevents Crippling Spores from decaying. Combined with
Unfair Advantage at Level 16, this will greatly improve both Lunara's damage and
chasing potential.
Abolish Magic can be a very useful Talent if the enemy
team is heavy on crowd control, such as Stuns,
Slows, and Roots. Furthermore,
it also counters damage over time effects like Kael'thas's Living Bomb,
which can be crucial to save an ally's life.
Greater Spell Shield is an incredibly useful Talent if
the enemy team has a lot of Spell Damage at their disposal.
If you diligently keep it disabled and only activate it when needed, this Talent
can reduce the damage potential of Heroes like Jaina
or Chromie significantly, so make
sure to carefully analyse the enemy team's composition.
Endless Spores can give some good value if you manage
to keep at least 2 Heroes affected by Nature's Toxin. If the enemy team has
a heavy backline for example, this Talent should not be picked.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Unfair Advantage is a quite reliable Talent,
since Lunara's Crippling Spores can be manually activated
to Slow enemy targets, which would then cause them
to take increased damage from her Nature's Toxin.
Star Wood Spear allows Lunara to attack from a large
distance. This prevents her from exposing herself to the enemy team, which is
very important for squishy Ranged Assassins in general.
Invigorating Spores causes Lunara to attack faster and deal more damage
to Heroes with high maximum Health. If the enemy frontline is too tanky,
this Talent is great to constantly pressure enemy Heroes and taking them down.
Accelerated Contamination adds a big QoL buff to Noxious Blossom
and should be picked when going for a Noxious Blossom Build. The recharge rate allows you to dish
out more Noxious Blossoms, equalling into more damage.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
For the Wildlands makes your Thornwood Vine shoot
four additional vines in an arc. This gives you an insane area of effect boost, which is
helpful in teamfights should the enemy team be more spread rather than stacked.
It's recommended to play with this talent in test-mode first to get the hang of how the arc works!
Boundless Stride provides Lunara with a reliable source of extra mobility, which
can be a valuable asset against high-mobility Heroes like Illidan or
Genji. If Unfair Advantage was taken at
Level 16, Boundless Stride can proc its extra damage even more frequently,
thanks to the Slow applied by Leaping Strike.
Forest's Wrath now makes it so your heroic abilities
stacks more of Nature's Toxin and increases the range of them both. This talent can be chosen
regardless of what you pick at level 10 and this talent benefits both of them greatly.
The range helps with either hitting the enemy backline more reliably or allowing you
to play more safe against enemy frontline. The passive increasing Lunara's vision
is a nice "cherry on the top".
Intensifying Toxin amplifies Lunara's damage on targets that
are affected by 3 Stacks of Nature's Toxin. Thanks to Talents like
Splintered Spear at Level 7, spreading poison damages should not
be too hard. As such, Intensifying Toxin becomes quite a reliable Talent in the late game.
This Talent synergizes very well with Lunara's other Talents.
Galloping Gait adds an incredible amount of mobility
to Lunara's kit. The 80% Movement Speed increase allows her to outrun every Hero in
the game, which can be used offensively and defensively. Against teams with
several Tanks and Melee Assassins,
in particular, this Talent allows Lunara
to survive on the battlefield and keep a healthy distance to enemy initiators.
